scope: PostEvent, FillRecord, OSEventAvail, GetOSEvent, DeleteEvt, and FlushEvents.

span.boundary_evidence: PostEvent begins at 0x4026ec. FlushEvents ends with RTS at 0x402850, before the TFSDispatch entry at 0x402852.

changes: Removed the later InitEvents procedure and idle, Help Manager, and Script Manager additions. Preserved applicable routine descriptions and change history through October 1985.
Restored LoIntMask, 0x0100, in all three event queue critical sections. Change C173 in September 1986 raised the mask to disable SCC interrupts; the Mac Plus ROM uses the earlier value.

Restored the word KeyLast test before the auto-key event-mask test. PostEvent receives a zero-extended copy of KeyLast. Changes C89 and C517 in July and December 1986 introduced the later keyboard message layout.
Restored GetOSEvent's original return path without the extra A0 save and Script Manager processing. The ROM directly removes the queue element after OSEventAvail succeeds.
Retained the October 1985 FlushEvents change that writes -1 to LastSPExtra. The ROM contains that write at 0x402812.
Removed later Trap suffixes, replaced imports with the verified Enqueue and Dequeue addresses, and made their PC-relative calls explicit. Selected the ROM branch widths and ADDQ encoding.
Copied required equates from the supplied interface files. Added marked reconstruction notes and kept the original copyright, author, and applicable comments.

verification.method: Translate the source syntax, expand its macro definitions, assemble for the 68000, link at the ROM address, and compare every emitted byte.
limitations: Instruction and data bytes match the entire span. The exact historical spelling and source layout of the restored instructions remain inferred.
Enqueue and Dequeue are verified separately in Queue.a. Other hardware and caller behavior lies outside this span.
